pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK — Exactly 10 seconds total duration, native portrait 9:16 aspect ratio, full-screen vertical composition with zero letterboxing or pillarboxing.

B. REALISM LOCK — 100% photorealistic physical-world footage. Absolutely no animation, no 2D/3D renders, no cartoon elements, no architectural CGI, no explainer graphics. Captured with real-world optics, natural daylight, authentic Tamil Nadu/Coimbatore urban textures, genuine asphalt, natural dust, real vehicle reflections, and true-to-life human scale.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK — The subject is location accessibility and ground-level infrastructure verification during property inspection. Based on 4 source evidence points: checking a verified operational hub, observing street traffic flow, inspecting approach infrastructure, and spotting an unexpected site defect (dampness) before committing. Applied strictly to Coimbatore real estate evaluation without generic promotion.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY — Uses macro inspection, eye-level street tracking, and ground-level evidence checking in Coimbatore. The default empty-plot to luxury-villa narrative is strictly forbidden. Every shot focuses on practical street approach, drainage, and surface reality.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY — Realistic smartphone/mirrorless camera aesthetic, stabilized handheld motion, natural focal lengths (24mm-50mm), realistic depth of field, authentic shadows, 4K clarity, stable geometry.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN:
- Shot 1 (0.0 - 1.4s): Eye-level tracking shot walking toward a busy Coimbatore commercial street with local storefronts and parked two-wheelers. Text: 'Ground Check'. VO: 'Brochure paathutu land edukatheenga.'
- Shot 2 (1.4 - 2.8s): Medium shot panning across an active Coimbatore arterial road with local auto-rickshaws. Text: 'Real Access'. VO: 'Neenga nerula poi'
- Shot 3 (2.8 - 4.2s): Low-angle close-up of local street asphalt and roadside drainage in Coimbatore daylight. Text: 'Road Width'. VO: 'road vasathi,'
- Shot 4 (4.2 - 5.6s): A parked green-and-yellow auto-rickshaw beside a plot boundary wall in Coimbatore under natural sunlight. Text: 'Connectivity'. VO: 'drainage mattum'
- Shot 5 (5.6 - 7.0s): Macro hand-held shot pointing down at damp soil and standing water near a property access point. Text: 'Inspect Dampness'. VO: 'ground reality-ah'
- Shot 6 (7.0 - 8.5s): Hand pointing toward a damp boundary marker on a Coimbatore site access path. Text: 'Verify First'. VO: 'check pannunga!'
- Shot 7 (8.5 - 10.0s): Static, crisp shot of a verified Coimbatore street corner with subtle brand overlay. Text: 'OliveTree Investors'. VO: 'OliveTree Investors - Smart Guidance.'

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT — Extremely subtle, clean typographic overlays on real footage only. No cartoon callouts.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE — No end card; finishes directly on the verified Coimbatore street scene with minimal OliveTree Investors branding.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES — Ban toon, cartoon, anime, 3D renders, CGI, fake skylines, floating buildings, morphing roads, distorted text, duplicated people, visible camera crew, religious markings, fake Coimbatore landmarks, landscape framing, black bars.
